question: A certain sum of money amounts to ₹12,000 in 3 years and ₹16,000 in 5 years on simple interest. Find the principal.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in amount (5 yr − 3 yr) = 16000 − 12000 = 4000

Time difference = 2 years ⇒ SI for 2 years = 4000

⇒ SI per year = 2000

Amount in 3 years = Principal + 3×2000 = 12000

**∴ Answer = 6000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount in 3 years = 12000, Amount in 5 years = 16000

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = Principal × Rate × Time ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Difference in amount = 16000 − 12000 = 4000

⇒ Time difference = 5 − 3 = 2 years

⇒ Interest for 2 years = 4000

⇒ Interest per year = 4000 ÷ 2 = 2000

⇒ Interest for 3 years = 2000 × 3 = 6000

⇒ Principal = 12000 − 6000

⇒ = 6000

**∴ The correct answer is 6000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

Amount Formula

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest

Key Insight

Difference of amounts gives interest for difference in time

Shortcut Trick

Find yearly interest first, then subtract from amount
